summary: Frontend-only verification of the friendly-status masking change (hide raw '· Ns' ticking counter, 'Slow response · Ns silent · auto-retry in Ms' pill text and manual 'Retry now' button behind reassuring rotating phrases from useFriendlyStatusPhrase). Verified via (a) source review of MessageBubble.jsx, StreamHealthPill.jsx, ChatPanel.jsx, useFriendlyStatusPhrase.js; (b) StreamHealthPill vitest suite (4/4 pass); (c) live UI login to preview + real chat send with test@aurem.dev. The chat-thinking span rendered 'Bear with me — our agents are working on it…' immediately after send (no raw '· Ns', no 'Retrying', no 'Reconnecting'). data-testid='chat-stream-retry-now' does not exist in DOM at any point. No forbidden literals ('Slow response', 'silent · auto-retry', 'auto-retry in', 'Retrying… (manual)', 'Reconnecting… (auto-recovery)') found on page. Normal send/receive regression passes — assistant reply streamed and completed cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: useFriendlyStatusPhrase.js correctly holds on the last phrase instead of looping to the first — prevents visible 'restart' feel on long waits.
ChatPanel.jsx line ~2023 sets `activity: undefined` on retry-transition so friendly phrase takes over — verified.
ChatPanel.jsx line ~4344 StreamHealthPill render no longer passes onRetry — verified.

Note: manualRetryRef.current is still assigned in ChatPanel.jsx (~line 2059) but has no UI trigger. It is dead code from the user's POV; safe to leave for now, but a future cleanup could remove it to reduce confusion.

Note: /dashboard-preview-v2 ChatView.jsx still contains the old 'Slow response · 34s silent · auto-retry in 56s' + 'Retry now' markup — confirmed labelled as Preview-only visual mock per request note; NOT flagged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The friendly-phrase masking is fully in effect on the real /dashboard chat surface. Phrase advancement over time (~4.5s intervals) is covered by unit test but hard to observe live because a typical reply completes in <5s; if you need to verify advancement, throttle the network or mock a slow SSE stream. Verify chat-stream-retry-now stays absent from DOM even during genuine 90s stalls (auto-retry path in performRetry / idle-watchdog).
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a masking/UX-copy change, not a bug fix. All acceptance criteria met.
